blocks.html: Set up Reports once so every report you send uses the right defaults without extra taps in the field. Open Settings > Tool Preferences > Specific Tool Preferences > Reporting Preferences.

slides.title: Set how reports are sent
slides.html: In General Settings, turn on Allow sending to ATAK users over Data Package to be prompted for a send method, and Send Report Data Package To All Contacts Automatically to push to everyone on the network. Use Always Show Queried Reports to keep server results on screen.

slides.title: Default your report location to self
slides.html: Enable Set report location to self marker by default so each new report drops on your own position. Saves you placing the marker by hand every time.

slides.title: Set default importance and scale
slides.html: Under Default Information, set Importance for the Default Report Importance and Event Scale for the Default Report Event Scale. New reports start with these values.

slides.title: Pick a default report template
slides.html: In Report Templates, set Default Report Type to the template you create most. Use Overwrite Reports with Defaults to customize reports made with that type.

slides.title: Set PDF export options
slides.html: Under Export to PDF, turn on Automatically Open PDFs to view each PDF as soon as it is created. Use Watermark Preferences to set the watermark to default, custom, or none.
